members.name: Preloader
members.text:
Preloader
This global object is responsible of managing the free ram by preloading and unloading cast members needed for the coming frames. It determines upon ceation the size of available ram, subtracts a safety block (750 Kb) and then manages loaded cast members using an LRU list (last used is last). It recieves requests in the form of lists of cast members to be loaded. If there is no more ram available it unloads the least recently used cast members (begining of the list). If a cast member that is needed is already loaded it is only moved to the end of the list, if it’s needed and it is loaded and it is not in the list (was loaded but not by the preloader) it is just added to the end of the list.

Properties:
addQue - A list of casts to be loaded.
remQue - Alist of casts to be unloaded.
loadedCasts - A simple list of cast numbers/names
mem - Available memory. Set at birth. Adjusted every time a cast is loaded or unloaded.

Methods:
birth
Create a new instance initialize mem to the freeBytes - 750 * 1024. Set loadedCasts to [] (empty list). Set addQue to [] (empty list). Set remQue to [] (empty list).
parameters:
me        return        object        This.

queLoad
Receive a list of cast members and add them to the addQue.
parameters:
me        in        object        This.
casts        in        list        The cast members to be loaded.

queUnload
Receieve a list of cast members and add them to the remQue.
parameters:
me        in        object        This.
casts        in        list        The cast members to be unloaded.

queGetMem
Produce a report (property list) describing memory state (FreeBytes, FreeBytes - 750, currently used by preloader, currently available to the preloader).
parameters:
me        in        object        This.
report        return        property list    The requested report.

onIdle
To be called by the movie or score on idle handler. Checks if the addQue is empty, if it is checks if the remQue is empty if it is leaves (exit) the handler. If the addQue is not empty loads cast members from it, according to the LRU algorithm described above. If the remQue is not empty, removes cast members from memory according to the algoritm described above.
parameters:
me        in        object        This.

members.name: slideShow control parent script
members.text:
The SlideShow controller
This object will control the way that the slideShow is running.

You should "birth" it at the start of each part of the slide show, and kill it at the end of it.

The methods:

--=========================== Start of user methods =======================--
Method: Birth 
Parameters:
me - the script of this object, should be: script "slideShow control parent script"
theQtSpriteNum - the sprite number of the QuickTime movie
theQueListField - the name or number of the que list Field
thePreLoadList - the nmae or number of the preLoad list field
theUnLoadList - the name or number of the unload list field
theQueFramesListField - the name or number of the list of que frames field
Return: this instance
Does: initiate the object


Method: edKill
Parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does: remove the object from the actorList and retunr void. use it as follow:
gMyObj = kill( gMyObj )

Method: onMouseUp
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does: Move the QT to the end of it in a case of mouse click. you should call this method from a movie mouseUp method.

Method: onIdle
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does: calls the preloader onidle method
you should call this method from an ON IDLE event in your movie.

Method: edGetName
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: return #slideShowControl
Does: return the name of this object.

--=========================== End of user methods =======================--

--====================== start of object internal methods ====================--

Method: stepFrame
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does: decide wether we reached a new que. If so advance to the next que, otherwise, loop the movie in the current que. If we are in record mode, it will just loop.
This method is called by director each time the movieHead is leaving a frame.

Method: edStepFrameForRunTime
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does: check if we should go to the next Que or stay in the current que.
This methis is called only by stepFrame

Method: edGetLoopFrame
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: the number of frame to jump to.
Does: returns the number of frame to jump to according to a flag that knows if we need to loop to marker(0) or to the frame.

Method: edGoToNextQue
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does:  return the number of the next frame to go to, after updateing the curQue number to the closest one the the current QT frame. It will also update the preloader lists of preload/unload.

Method: edGetQueFrameNum
parameters:
whichQue - the number of que to check
Return: the number of frame that this que starts with.
Does: retreive the number of the first frame that the given que starts in.

Method: edUpdateLoopMode
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does: set the property fLoopOneFrame to True if current frame name have the string ",loopOneFrame" at the end of it. otherwise it will set it to False.

Method: edCleanOldInstance
parameters:
me - this object instance
Return: void
Does: Check if there is another instance of that object in the actorList and if so, it will remove it.
--====================== End of object internal methods ====================--
